title: Monorepo setup: Turborepo + pnpm workspaces
body:
## Overview
Initialise the Poolr monorepo with Turborepo and pnpm workspaces. This is the foundation all other work depends on.

## Tasks
- [ ] Initialise pnpm workspace with `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
- [ ] Configure `turbo.json` with `dev`, `build`, `test`, and `lint` pipelines
- [ ] Scaffold `apps/api`, `apps/web`, `apps/mobile`, `apps/admin` directories
- [ ] Scaffold `packages/database`, `packages/types`, `packages/ui`, `packages/config`, `packages/utils`
- [ ] Add shared TypeScript config in `tooling/typescript/`
- [ ] Add shared ESLint config in `tooling/eslint/`
- [ ] Add root `package.json` with workspace scripts
- [ ] Add `docker-compose.yml` for local PostgreSQL and Redis
- [ ] Add `.env.example` with all required variables
- [ ] Add root `README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- `pnpm install` succeeds from root
- `pnpm dev` starts all apps concurrently via Turborepo
- `pnpm build` succeeds for all packages
- Docker Compose brings up PostgreSQL on 5432 and Redis on 6379

title: Database: Prisma schema and initial migrations
body:
## Overview
Define the full Prisma schema for Poolr and run the initial migration.

## Schema entities
- `User` (id, full_name, email, phone, password_hash, role, status)
- `KycProfile` (id, user_id, bvn, nin, selfie_url, id_doc_url, kyc_status, verified_at)
- `Group` (id, admin_id, name, contribution_amount, currency, frequency, max_members, status, start_date)
- `GroupMember` (id, group_id, user_id, rotation_position, member_status, joined_at)
- `Cycle` (id, group_id, recipient_id, cycle_number, due_date, payout_date, status)
- `Contribution` (id, cycle_id, member_id, amount, status, paystack_ref, paid_at, due_at)
- `Payout` (id, cycle_id, recipient_id, amount, status, paystack_transfer_code, initiated_at, completed_at)
- `Penalty` (id, contribution_id, member_id, penalty_amount, reason, status, applied_at)
- `Wallet` (id, user_id, balance, currency, updated_at)
- `WalletTransaction` (id, wallet_id, amount, type, direction, reference, created_at)
- `Notification` (id, user_id, title, body, channel, status, sent_at)

## Tasks
- [ ] Write full Prisma schema in `packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma`
- [ ] Define all enums: `Role`, `GroupStatus`, `CycleStatus`, `KycStatus`, `ContribStatus`, `PenaltyReason`, `NotifChannel`, `TxDirection`
- [ ] Run `prisma migrate dev --name init`
- [ ] Export typed Prisma client from `packages/database/src/index.ts`
- [ ] Write seed script with sample user, group, and cycle data
- [ ] Add `db:migrate`, `db:seed`, and `db:studio` scripts to package.json

## Acceptance criteria
- `pnpm --filter @poolr/database db:migrate` runs without errors
- `pnpm --filter @poolr/database db:seed` populates local DB
- Prisma client is importable from other packages as `@poolr/database`

title: API: Authentication module (register, login, OTP, JWT)
body:
## Overview
Implement the full authentication flow: registration, login, OTP-based phone verification, JWT access/refresh token issuance and rotation.

## Endpoints
- `POST /auth/register` - create account, trigger OTP
- `POST /auth/verify-otp` - verify phone OTP, activate account
- `POST /auth/login` - email+password login, return access + refresh tokens
- `POST /auth/refresh` - exchange refresh token for new access token
- `POST /auth/logout` - invalidate refresh token
- `POST /auth/resend-otp` - resend OTP to phone

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `AuthModule`, `AuthController`, `AuthService`
- [ ] Implement `JwtStrategy` with `passport-jwt`
- [ ] Implement JWT access token (15 min) and refresh token (30 day) issuance
- [ ] Store refresh tokens in Redis with TTL
- [ ] Integrate Termii SMS for OTP delivery
- [ ] Implement OTP generation, hashing, and verification
- [ ] Create `JwtAuthGuard` and `RolesGuard` in `common/guards/`
- [ ] Create `@Roles()` decorator
- [ ] Hash passwords with `bcrypt`
- [ ] Write unit tests for `AuthService`
- [ ] Write e2e tests for all auth endpoints

## Acceptance criteria
- Full register → OTP verify → login → token refresh flow works end to end
- Expired/invalid tokens return 401
- OTP expires after 10 minutes
- Refresh token is rotated on each use

title: API: Users module (profile, KYC submission)
body:
## Overview
Build the users module covering profile management and KYC document submission via Smile ID.

## Endpoints
- `GET /users/me` - get own profile
- `PATCH /users/me` - update profile (name, profile photo)
- `POST /users/me/kyc` - submit KYC (BVN, NIN, selfie, ID document)
- `GET /users/me/kyc` - get KYC status
- `GET /users/:id` - get another user's public profile (admin only)

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `UsersModule`, `UsersController`, `UsersService`
- [ ] Create `KycService` wrapping Smile ID API
- [ ] Implement BVN verification via Smile ID
- [ ] Implement NIN verification via Smile ID
- [ ] Upload selfie and ID document to S3, store URL in `KycProfile`
- [ ] Implement KYC status webhook handler from Smile ID
- [ ] Create `KycGuard` - blocks group join if KYC not verified
- [ ] Write unit tests for `UsersService` and `KycService`

## Acceptance criteria
- User can submit KYC and track status
- Smile ID webhook updates `kyc_status` to `VERIFIED` or `REJECTED`
- KYC documents are stored in S3, not the database
- Unverified users cannot join groups

title: API: Groups module (create, invite, manage members)
body:
## Overview
Build the groups module: group creation, member invitations, rotation assignment, and group lifecycle management.

## Endpoints
- `POST /groups` - create group (admin only)
- `GET /groups` - list groups the current user belongs to
- `GET /groups/:id` - get group details
- `PATCH /groups/:id` - update group settings (admin only)
- `POST /groups/:id/invite` - invite a member by phone or email
- `POST /groups/:id/join` - accept an invitation
- `DELETE /groups/:id/members/:memberId` - remove a member (admin only)
- `PATCH /groups/:id/members/:memberId/position` - update rotation position (admin only)
- `POST /groups/:id/start` - lock group and generate cycles

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `GroupsModule`, `GroupsController`, `GroupsService`
- [ ] Create `RotationService` - generates `Cycle` rows from member rotation order
- [ ] Implement invitation via unique token (email/SMS link)
- [ ] Enforce max_members limit
- [ ] Enforce KYC gate on join
- [ ] `POST /groups/:id/start` locks membership and calls `RotationService.generateCycles()`
- [ ] Write unit tests for `GroupsService` and `RotationService`

## Acceptance criteria
- Admin can create a group and invite members
- Joining without KYC returns 403
- `start` endpoint generates one `Cycle` row per member with correct recipient and due dates
- Rotation positions cannot be changed after group starts

title: API: Payments module (Paystack integration, contributions)
body:
## Overview
Integrate Paystack for collecting member contributions and disbursing payouts. Handle the full payment lifecycle.

## Endpoints
- `POST /payments/contribute/:cycleId` - initialise Paystack transaction for contribution
- `GET /payments/verify/:reference` - verify a Paystack payment
- `POST /payments/webhook` - Paystack webhook receiver (no JWT auth, HMAC verified)
- `GET /payments/contributions` - list own contributions
- `GET /payments/payouts` - list own payouts

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `PaymentsModule`, `PaymentsController`, `PaymentsService`
- [ ] Create `PaystackService` - wrapper for Paystack REST API (initialize, verify, transfer)
- [ ] Create `WebhookController` - separate controller, no JWT guard, HMAC signature verification
- [ ] Handle `charge.success` webhook: mark `Contribution` as PAID, credit `Wallet`
- [ ] Handle `transfer.success` webhook: mark `Payout` as COMPLETED
- [ ] Handle `transfer.failed` webhook: retry or flag for admin review
- [ ] Implement idempotency - ignore duplicate webhook events by reference
- [ ] Store Paystack references on `Contribution` and `Payout` rows
- [ ] Write unit tests for `PaystackService` and `PaymentsService`

## Acceptance criteria
- Member can initiate a contribution and be redirected to Paystack checkout
- `charge.success` webhook marks contribution PAID within 5 seconds
- Duplicate webhooks are safely ignored
- HMAC verification rejects requests with invalid signatures (return 400)

title: API: Payout scheduler (BullMQ processor)
body:
## Overview
Build the automated payout scheduler that runs each cycle's disbursement on the due date via a BullMQ queue.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `SchedulerModule` with BullMQ queue named `payout`
- [ ] Create `PayoutProcessor` - processes `payout` jobs
- [ ] Schedule daily cron job (`@nestjs/schedule`) to enqueue payout jobs for cycles due today
- [ ] `PayoutProcessor`: verify all contributions for cycle are PAID, then call `PaystackService.initiateTransfer()`
- [ ] Handle partial collection: if not all members paid, apply penalties then still disburse (configurable per group)
- [ ] Add retry logic (3 attempts, exponential backoff) for failed Paystack transfers
- [ ] Emit events on payout initiation and completion for the notifications module to consume
- [ ] Write unit tests for `PayoutProcessor`

## Acceptance criteria
- Payout jobs are enqueued at midnight for all cycles due that day
- Paystack transfer is initiated automatically without manual intervention
- Failed jobs retry up to 3 times before being moved to the dead-letter queue
- Admin is notified if a payout enters the dead-letter queue

title: API: Penalty engine
body:
## Overview
Implement the penalty engine that detects missed and late contributions and applies configured penalties.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `PenaltiesModule`, `PenaltiesService`
- [ ] Create BullMQ `reminder` queue and `ReminderProcessor`
- [ ] Schedule reminders: 48hr before due, 24hr before due, on due date
- [ ] Day-after-due cron: mark unpaid contributions as MISSED, create `Penalty` row
- [ ] `PenaltyService.applyPenalty()` - calculates penalty amount (flat fee or % of contribution, per group config)
- [ ] Add `penalty_config` JSONB field to `Group` model (penalty_type, penalty_amount, grace_period_hours)
- [ ] Expose `GET /penalties/me` - list own penalties
- [ ] Expose `POST /penalties/:id/waive` - admin can waive a penalty
- [ ] Notify member when a penalty is applied

## Acceptance criteria
- Members receive reminders 48h and 24h before due date
- Missed contribution creates a `Penalty` row the day after due date
- Penalty amount is calculated correctly for both flat and percentage modes
- Admin can waive individual penalties

title: API: Notifications module (push, email, SMS)
body:
## Overview
Build a unified notifications module that dispatches messages across push (FCM), email (Resend), and SMS (Termii) channels.

## Notification events to handle
- Welcome / account verified
- KYC approved / rejected
- Group invitation received
- Group started
- Contribution reminder (48h, 24h, due day)
- Contribution received confirmation
- Payout received
- Penalty applied
- Payout failed (admin)

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `NotificationsModule`, `NotificationsService`
- [ ] Create `PushService` - wraps Firebase Admin SDK (FCM)
- [ ] Create `EmailService` - wraps Resend SDK with React Email templates
- [ ] Create `SmsService` - wraps Termii API
- [ ] Store FCM device tokens on `User` model
- [ ] Persist every notification to `Notification` table
- [ ] Expose `GET /notifications` - paginated list of own notifications
- [ ] Expose `PATCH /notifications/:id/read` - mark as read

- Each notification event dispatches to the correct channel(s)
- All sent notifications are persisted to DB
- Failed FCM pushes fall back gracefully (log, don't throw)

title: API: Wallet module
body:
## Overview
Build the internal wallet system for tracking each user's Poolr balance and transaction history.

## Endpoints
- `GET /wallet` - get own wallet balance
- `GET /wallet/transactions` - paginated transaction history

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `WalletModule`, `WalletService`
- [ ] `WalletService.credit(userId, amount, reference)` - atomic balance update + `WalletTransaction` insert
- [ ] `WalletService.debit(userId, amount, reference)` - with insufficient-balance guard
- [ ] Use Prisma transactions (`$transaction`) to ensure wallet balance and transaction log stay in sync
- [ ] Trigger wallet credit on `charge.success` webhook
- [ ] Write unit tests for `WalletService`

## Acceptance criteria
- Wallet balance is always consistent with transaction log
- Concurrent credits/debits do not cause race conditions (use Prisma `$transaction` with optimistic locking)
- Insufficient balance returns 422 with clear error message

title: API: Admin endpoints (group overview, member management, payout controls)
body:
## Overview
Expose admin-only endpoints for the collector dashboard covering group oversight, member management, and manual payout controls.

## Endpoints
- `GET /admin/groups` - list all groups with stats
- `GET /admin/groups/:id/cycles` - cycle summary with contribution status per member
- `GET /admin/groups/:id/members` - member list with KYC and payment status
- `POST /admin/groups/:id/cycles/:cycleId/trigger-payout` - manually trigger a payout
- `GET /admin/penalties` - list all pending penalties
- `POST /admin/penalties/:id/waive` - waive a penalty
- `GET /admin/users` - user list with KYC status (super admin)

## Tasks
- [ ] Add `ADMIN` and `SUPER_ADMIN` role checks via `RolesGuard`
- [ ] Implement cycle summary query (contributions received vs expected per cycle)
- [ ] Manual payout trigger calls `PayoutProcessor` job directly
- [ ] Write e2e tests for admin endpoints

## Acceptance criteria
- Non-admin users receive 403 on all `/admin` routes
- Cycle summary correctly shows paid/unpaid/missed per member
- Manual payout trigger works even when scheduler hasn't fired

title: CI/CD: GitHub Actions pipelines
body:
## Overview
Set up GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration and deployment.

## Workflows

### `ci.yml` - runs on every PR
- [ ] Install dependencies (`pnpm install`)
- [ ] Type check all packages (`tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Lint all packages (`eslint`)
- [ ] Run unit tests (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Build all packages (`pnpm build`)

### `deploy-api.yml` - runs on merge to `main`
- [ ] Build Docker image for `apps/api`
- [ ] Push to Railway via Railway CLI or Deploy Hook

### `deploy-web.yml` - runs on merge to `main`
- [ ] Deploy `apps/web` to Vercel via Vercel CLI

### `deploy-admin.yml` - runs on merge to `main`
- [ ] Deploy `apps/admin` to Vercel

## Tasks
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/deploy-api.yml`
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/deploy-web.yml`
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/deploy-admin.yml`
- [ ] Add required secrets to GitHub repo settings
- [ ] Add branch protection rule: PRs require passing CI before merge

## Acceptance criteria
- PRs cannot be merged without passing CI
- Merge to `main` automatically deploys all apps
- Failed deployments notify the team via GitHub status checks

title: Web: KYC verification flow
body:
## Overview
Build the KYC onboarding flow - a multi-step form collecting BVN, NIN, selfie, and ID document.

## Steps
1. Enter BVN
2. Enter NIN
3. Upload selfie (camera capture or file upload)
4. Upload government-issued ID (front)
5. Review and submit
6. Pending / approved / rejected status screen

## Tasks
- [ ] Build multi-step form with progress indicator
- [ ] Implement camera capture for selfie using `getUserMedia` API
- [ ] Implement file upload for ID document with preview
- [ ] Upload files directly to S3 via pre-signed URL (avoid routing through API)
- [ ] Poll KYC status after submission or handle via webhook-triggered status update
- [ ] Show clear messaging for each status: pending, verified, rejected (with reason)

## Acceptance criteria
- User can complete full KYC flow without leaving the app
- Camera capture works on Chrome, Safari, and Firefox
- Files over 5MB are rejected with a helpful message
- KYC status updates are reflected in the UI without a page refresh
